title: What Liquid Democracy Markets Is
definition: Liquid Democracy Markets: delegation markets for liquid democracy.
description:
Liquid Democracy Markets: delegation markets for liquid democracy. This is Post-Scarcity Economy at its most ambitious — vote tokens research, market logistics engineering and delegation chains operations converging on a single goal: making market hulls real.

Why it matters: Post-Scarcity Economy will decide transparency outcomes this century. Liquid Democracy Markets is one of the load-bearing ideas: without working market hulls, the larger vote tokens vision stalls, and with it, the market logistics systems that depend on it.

This database documents Liquid Democracy Markets in full: what it is, the real research behind it today, the pieces it is built from, dated forecasts, runnable demo programs, and a teaching ladder from foundations to mastery. Every record carries a working program you can run.

t: Real Research Today: Liquid Democracy Markets
title: Real Research Today: Liquid Democracy Markets
definition: Today's documented research behind Liquid Democracy Markets.
description:
The road to Liquid Democracy Markets is already being paved. Quadratic funding (Gitcoin) has distributed $60M+ to public goods via matching markets. Open-source hardware (Arduino, RISC-V) shows zero-marginal-cost production at scale.

Kenya's GiveDirectly UBI trials and Stockton's SEED program tested basic income at city scale. Together these programs form the vote tokens foundation that Liquid Democracy Markets will build on — the market logistics results, the delegation chains methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as market logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

t: 2030 — First city-scale market hulls pilots launch: vote tokens issuanc
title: 2030 — First city-scale market hulls pilots launch: vote tokens issuanc
definition: 2030 milestone on the Liquid Democracy Markets roadmap.
description:
First city-scale market hulls pilots launch: vote tokens issuance and market logistics exchange running live.

What must be true first: the vote tokens results have to replicate outside the lab, market logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and delegation chains operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed vote tokens demonstrations, market logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting delegation chains uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Liquid Democracy Markets
definition: Estimates Liquid Democracy Markets readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Liquid Democracy Markets components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a market hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Liquid Democracy Markets Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Liquid Democracy Markets operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Liquid Democracy Markets installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 55622 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where vote tokens monitoring, market logistics redundancy, or delegation chains maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Liquid Democracy Markets Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Liquid Democracy Markets: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Liquid Democracy Markets — delegation markets for liquid democracy.

Phase 1 — Prove (vote tokens): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (market logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (delegation chains): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (transparency): market hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and governance-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
